reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is circular (stability is maintained because of stability) and lacks a specific mechanism; it also incorrectly invokes ductility as a cause of thermal stability in nanoparticles.
reasons.testability: The test is clear (XRD/SEM on CoCrCuFeMnNix with varying Ni), but the falsification criterion is essentially a restatement of the hypothesis, making it a weak test.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis merely restates the desired outcome as the mechanism, offering no actionable insight into what governs stability, so it is not useful.
